# CNB Bank

> CNB Bank is a regional Pennsylvania-based financial institution serving customers across Pennsylvania and Ohio with comprehensive banking products, fraud prevention resources, and financial education tools.

CNB Bank operates as part of CNB Financial Corporation with multiple regional divisions. The site emphasizes customer service, security, and financial literacy through its Education Center, fraud prevention hub, and comprehensive support channels.

## Key Topics

- Online Banking & eBanking
- Fraud Prevention & Security
- Customer Service
- Branch & ATM Locator
- Financial Education
- Financial Wellness
- Financial Calculators
- Credit Reports
- Phishing Protection
- Pennsylvania & Ohio Banking
- Personal Banking
- Small Business Fraud Prevention
- Financial Counseling
- Banking Security Best Practices
- Retirement Planning

- [CNB Bank - Culture & Careers](https://cnbbank.bank/who-we-are/culture-careers): CNB Bank career opportunities, culture, and employee benefits

## Customer Support & Contact

- [CNB Bank - Contact Us](https://cnbbank.bank/contact-us): Contact information and support channels for CNB Bank customers

## Security & Fraud Prevention

- [CNB Bank - Fraud Security Hub](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/fraud-security-hub): Fraud prevention guide covering scams, phishing, and card skimming
- [CNB Bank - Online Banking Security](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/online-banking-security): Online security best practices and fraud prevention guidelines
- [CNB Bank - Small Business Guide to Fraud](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/small-business-guide-to-fraud): Fraud prevention guide for small business accounts and operations

## Financial Education & Resources

- [CNB Bank - Education Center](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center): Financial education resources covering security, wellness, and tools
- [CNB Bank - Financial Wellness Center](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/financial-wellness-center): Financial literacy and wellness resources via EverFi platform
- [CNB Bank - Financial Calculators](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/financial-calculators): Financial tools for mortgage, auto, retirement, and debt planning
- [CNB Bank - Financial Counseling](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/financial-counseling): HUD-approved financial and credit counseling resource directory
- [CNB Bank - Free Credit Reports](https://cnbbank.bank/education-center/free-credit-reports): Guide to free annual credit reports from major credit bureaus
